column4: Repair task-journal/dashboard status fidelity: a mesh-task audit BLOCKED row must remain visibly BLOCKED in tasks.journal and the witness pane, never be relabelled QUEUED merely to keep it unfinished. Keep queue --dispatch restricted to truly claimable current OPEN steps; retain explicit blocker type/retry and HELD_REJECTED visibility. Add focused materializer and rendered-pane regressions that prove blocked work is visible yet absent from dispatch, and verify source/deployed tool parity.
